info.name: Project Tracker API
info.description: Authentication, Overview, Projects, Tasks and milestones, People and teams. Run the whole collection in order: each folder logs in the roles it needs and stores ids in collection variables.

variable.description: Local proxy. Cloud: https://<cloudfront-domain>/api/api. Direct uvicorn: http://localhost:8000

exec: pm.test('error envelope', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.error.code).to.eql('INVALID_CREDENTIALS'); });

item.name: Overview
item.description: One call per role's Overview page. Run 'Login' (emp001) first; this folder logs in mgr001 and adm001 itself.

exec: pm.test('no completed tasks listed', () => pm.expect(body.tasks.every(t => t.status !== 'completed')).to.be.true);
pm.test('3 milestones, last locked', () => pm.expect(body.focus.milestones.map(m => m.locked)).to.eql([false, false, true]));

item.name: Manager overview - project_id not a number

exec: pm.test('portfolio has both projects', () => pm.expect(body.portfolio.map(p => p.code)).to.include.members(['INF-024', 'OPS-018']));
pm.test('has INF-024 and OPS-018', () => { const codes = pm.response.json().map(p => p.code); pm.expect(codes).to.include('INF-024'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('OPS-018'); });

item.name: List projects - manager sees own only
List projects - employee sees joined, with own figures
Project detail - manager, another manager's project
Update project - manager cannot reassign manager

exec: const tasks = pm.response.json().tasks; pm.collectionVariables.set('assignedTaskId', tasks.find(t => t.display_status === 'assigned').id); pm.collectionVariables.set('blockedTaskId', tasks.find(t => t.display_status === 'blocked').id);

item.name: Milestone detail - employee sees own tasks
Create task - assignee not on project

exec: pm.test('locked until the previous one is approved', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().locked).to.be.true);

item.name: People and teams
item.description: Slice 4: admin people management, manager teams and direct reports, employee My teams. Needs the Projects folder first (managerProjectId, otherProjectId).

item.name: List people - search and role filter

exec: pm.test('has projects and blockers', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.projects).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.blockers).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Change role - blocked by open tasks
Direct report profile - not my report
Team options - every employee with their manager
Release direct report - blocked by open tasks
Update direct report - rate is forbidden

exec: pm.test('manager and teams', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.manager.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.teams.length).to.be.above(0); });
